# Test data

* `real/` — response files taken from the test data of the
  [evalresp](https://github.com/EarthScope/evalresp) project (GNU LGPL v3):
  `RESP.IU.ANMO.00.BHZ`, `RESP.IM.ATTU..BHE` (response list, blockette 55),
  `RESP.Z.CGV..HYZ` and the StationXML file `station-3.xml`, together with
  `station-3.xml2resp.resp`, the output of evalresp's own `xml2resp` converter for it.
* `synthetic/` — small RESP files generated by `tools/make_synthetic.py`, covering filter
  types and code paths that the real data does not (Hz poles/zeros, Z-transform
  poles/zeros, IIR coefficients, odd-symmetric and continued FIR, gain renormalization,
  displacement/acceleration/nm input units, single-stage and gain-only stages).
* `golden/golden.json` — reference results computed by the C `evalresp` program for every
  fixture channel and a matrix of options (see `tools/make_golden.py`).  The test-suite
  checks this package against these numbers, so the C program is not required to run tests.
